appDescription: SAIGIL helps a driver and a passenger talk on the road by suggesting how to open a topic and which saved topic fits the moment.

function.name: RECOMMEND_OPENER
function.description: Suggests three different ways to start a conversation about a topic the user names, worded for the person riding with the user.

topic.description: The topic the user wants to talk about, in the user's own words.

companion.description: The saved profile name of the person riding with the user.

function.name: RECOMMEND_SAVED_TOPIC
function.description: Picks up to three topics the user saved earlier that fit the current situation the user describes.

context.description: The current situation in one or two sentences, in the user's own words.

companion.description: The saved profile name of the person riding with the user.

function.name: SAVE_TOPIC
function.description: Saves a topic the user wants to talk about later.

topic.description: The topic to save, in the user's own words.

companion.description: The saved profile name of the person the topic is about.
